description: A function that takes settings and returns a decorator: `@retry(times=2)` means `f = retry(times=2)(f)`.
A decorator that accepts the function as an optional first argument, so `@retry` and `@retry(...)` both work.
State created inside the decorator body exists once per decorated function and is shared by all its calls.
A time source passed as a parameter so tests control time instead of sleeping.
A rate limit that counts the calls made during the last `period` seconds, forgetting older ones.
